places.name: Baiguate Waterfall
places.ai_summary: Baiguate Waterfall is a serene natural attraction surrounded by lush greenery, offering a refreshing escape and scenic beauty.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the short hike to the falls.

places.ai_summary: Jimenoa Waterfalls are a pair of cascading falls, accessible via a suspension bridge, offering breathtaking views and tranquility.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during heavy rains.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning scenery.

places.name: Pico Duarte Trek (Caribbean’s Highest Peak)
places.ai_summary: Pico Duarte is the highest peak in the Caribbean, offering a challenging trek with rewarding views and a unique adventure experience.

opening_hours.notes: Guided treks recommended.

places.place_tip: Pack warm clothing as temperatures drop at higher altitudes.

places.name: Jarabacoa Rafting on Yaque del Norte River
places.ai_summary: Experience the thrill of rafting on the Yaque del Norte River, the longest river in the Dominican Republic, known for its exciting rapids and stunning scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Wear quick-drying clothes and water shoes.
places.address: Yaque del Norte River, Jarabacoa, Dominican Republic

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Take the time to enjoy the natural pool at the base of the waterfall.

places.name: Valle Nuevo National Park
places.ai_summary: Valle Nuevo National Park is a protected area in the Dominican Republic, known for its cool climate, pine forests, and unique wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Check road conditions before visiting.

places.place_tip: Visit the park's visitor center for information on trails and wildlife.
places.address: Valle Nuevo National Park, Dominican Republic

places.ai_summary: Enjoy a scenic drive through Paso Bajito Valley, where you can experience the beauty of the Dominican countryside, with its mountains, rivers, and lush vegetation.

places.place_tip: Stop at viewpoints to take photos of the stunning landscape.

places.ai_summary: Visit the beautiful flower greenhouses in Constanza, where you can see a variety of flowers and plants, and learn about the local horticulture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the vibrant colors of the flowers.

places.name: Monumento Natural Las Neblinas
places.ai_summary: Monumento Natural Las Neblinas is a natural monument in the Dominican Republic, known for its cloud forest, diverse flora and fauna, and hiking opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the dry season.

places.place_tip: Dress in layers, as it can be cool and misty in the cloud forest.
places.address: Monumento Natural Las Neblinas, Dominican Republic

places.name: Mountain Horseback Tours
places.ai_summary: Explore the mountains of the Dominican Republic on a horseback tour, suitable for all levels, offering a unique perspective of the landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Wear long pants and closed-toe shoes for comfort.

places.ai_summary: El Mogote is a hiking trail in the Dominican Republic, offering a moderate trek with rewarding views of the surrounding mountains and valleys.

places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and wear sturdy hiking shoes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for local events.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food available around the square.

places.ai_summary: The Constanza Local Market is a vibrant market in the town of Constanza, where you can find a variety of local products, crafts, and fresh produce.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Bargaining is common, so don't hesitate to negotiate prices.

places.ai_summary: The Eco Lodge Overlook Points offer stunning panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys, and are a great spot for nature photography.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the sunset views.
